about_the_game:
This is the full Dice Gambit original soundtrack!  

The music is composed by the wonderful amazing Remagic KV aka Paulo Cunha. Links to his various socials are in the side-bar; check him out and give him your support!

The soundtrack consists of 40 wholly unique songs, mixing authentic Portuguese Fado with contemporary genres such as Hip-Hop, Edm, Funk and Trap.  

Come vibe with us, and take a piece of Neo-Talis with you home!

Buying this soundtrack supports a fledgling indie studio and the talented composer behind it. Thank you so much!
